section.title: org.osgi.service.cdi.reference
section.para: CDI Integration Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.

listitem.para: BeanServiceObjects - Allows multiple service objects for a service to be obtained.
BindBeanServiceObjects - A bean provided by CCR for binding actions to life cycle events of matching services.
BindService - A bean provided by CCR for binding actions to life cycle events of matching services.
BindServiceReference - A bean provided by CCR for binding actions to life cycle events of matching services.

section.title: public interface BeanServiceObjects<S>
section.para: Allows multiple service objects for a service to be obtained.
A component instance can receive a BeanServiceObjects object via a reference that is typed BeanServiceObjects.
For services with prototype scope, multiple service objects for the service can be obtained. For services with singleton or bundle scope, only one, use-counted service object is available.
Any unreleased service objects obtained from this BeanServiceObjects object are automatically released by Service Component Runtime when the service becomes unbound.

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public S getService()
section.para: Returns a service object for the associated service.
This method will always return null when the associated service has been become unbound.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A service object for the associated service or null if the service is unbound, the customized service object returned by a ServiceFactory does not implement the classes under which it was registered or the ServiceFactory threw an exception.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the component instance that received this BeanServiceObjects object has been deactivated.

section.title: public ServiceReference<S> getServiceReference()
section.para: Returns the ServiceReference for the service associated with this BeanServiceObjects object.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The ServiceReference for the service associated with this BeanServiceObjects object.

section.title: public void ungetService(S service)

formalpara.title: service
formalpara.para: A service object previously provided by this ReferenceServiceObjects object.

section.para: Releases a service object for the associated service.
The specified service object must no longer be used and all references to it should be destroyed after calling this method.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the component instance that received this ReferenceServiceObjects object has been deactivated.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the specified service object was not provided by this BeanServiceObjects object.

formalpara.title: action

section.para: Subscribe an action to the adding service event.
Only the last adding action is used.

section.title: public void bind()
section.para: The bind terminal operation is required to instruct CCR that all the bind actions have been specified, otherwise bind actions will never be called by CCR.
Calling bind again has no effect.
